summary: The sha1 filter returns a SHA-1 hash; SHA-1 may be blocked under FIPS and is insecure for security uses.
questions: How do I get a SHA-1 hash in Ansible?
Why does sha1 fail on a FIPS-enabled system?

answer_card.title: sha1 filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ data | sha1 }}` returns the SHA-1 hash. It requires SHA-1 to be available; security contexts like **FIPS** may prevent it. SHA-1 is insecure and not recommended for security uses.
